textRuns.value: The storage stack of the tables over time

Section 10.2 of the object model: Live is the data the tables still hold; the waste is Non-live, Unreferenced, Deleted, and Stale; the overhead is Metadata and Footers. Total is the seven together, and Waste Share is Waste over Data, Live plus Waste. A period shows the tables of its last collection day, each table once, from its latest collection of that day. Sizes are in units of 1,000 bytes.
